man.ls: ls [folder]  - list what's in a folder.
man.cd: cd FOLDER  - go into a folder. cd .. goes back out. cd alone goes home.
man.kill: kill NAME  - stop a process (if you're allowed).
man.pkg: pkg list | pkg install NAME  - programs from the State software center.
man.open: open FILE  - open a file or folder in its app.
man.whoami: whoami  - who you are, according to the State.
